necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that are concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate these symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197.
